name: Cliff Crawler

assets.label: Cliff Crawler — corps, deux orientations
assets.prompt: Create an original Yautja-inspired creature or vehicle design for the 2D fan-game La Longue Chasse. Not a canonical franchise replica. Exactly TWO complete side-profile views arranged SIDE BY SIDE, two columns ONE ROW, left view faces RIGHT and right view faces LEFT. Separately draw the opposite side of the SAME design at identical scale and anatomy. Flat PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF background. No shadows, scenery, text, watermark, panels, grid, ground or effects. Both full silhouettes entirely inside their own half with generous blank margins and no parts crossing the center gutter. Detailed hand-painted production bitmap for horizontal side-scrolling play. No people, rider, cargo, mounted weapon, trophy or detachable saddle baked in. Keep body and attachments separable. Compact mountain climbing robotic walker, exactly SIX mechanical legs: three near-side legs and three far-side legs, each pair offset so six individual claw feet can be counted. Low flattened black bronze body, open EMPTY central pilot well with integral console, rear enclosed battery, articulated spider-like legs ending in broad magnetic adhesion claw pads. Balanced standing pose. All legs emerge from three paired body stations, joints plausible and matching between opposite sides. No seventh limb, no wheels, no gun, no organic flesh. Clear distinct silhouette from a four-legged Jungle Strider.
notes: Vue d’identité et non animation. Anatomie, raccords et modules à valider avant intégration.

assets.prompt: Correct the provided Cliff Crawler identity sheet. Keep the SAME dark bronze chassis and EMPTY cockpit and TWO side-by-side opposite-facing views on uniform MAGENTA. Critical mechanical correction: EACH vehicle must show exactly SIX independently visible complete mechanical legs and SIX separated feet. Current image only shows five feet; add the missing FAR MIDDLE leg with a visible hip connector under the mid-body, slim upper shaft, bent knee, lower shaft and adhesion-claw foot. Move the far feet to stagger across the gaps: count front-near, front-far, middle-near, middle-far, rear-near, rear-far. Do not add seven, do not count toes as legs. Every leg is attached to its correct paired hip station; no floating foot. Use a slightly elevated SIDE game camera if necessary to expose the missing far-middle foot behind the near middle leg, but preserve horizontal profile, consistent scale and full blank margins. No rider, weapons, text, arrows, numbered labels, floor, shadows, glow or extra views. Precise hand-painted sci-fi vehicle bitmap.

Every one of six legs needs visible body socket, upper arm, knee, lower shaft and full foot. Do not remove an existing leg and do not add seven. ONE vehicle only, facing RIGHT, strict side-profile chassis, full frame and margins. Empty cockpit. No grid, text, labels, arrows, ground, shadow, rider, weapon, wheels, extra view or effects.
